marisol (AE): Hey team — Prospect (NovusPay) asked for a short POC: mixed workload (50% embeddings, 50% chat gen), sustained 300 qps, with microbursts to 2k qps for 60s. Can we confirm plan and rough cost?
eli (Solutions Eng): Sounds doable. We'll need to define prompt sizes and embedding dims. Also they want KMS + customer key, so note potential added latency.
jordan (SRE): Quick questions: which model family are they testing? Llama-2-70B-quant or an LLM-lite? We should size GPUs accordingly.
marisol (AE): They asked to compare open 70B quant vs 13B q4. Primary goal is <150ms median gen latency for 512-token responses on p95 tail under sustained load.
eli (Solutions Eng): OK. Proposed plan: 
- 30m smoke (sanity)
- 1h sustained ramp to 300 qps (steady-state)
- 3 x 60s microbursts @2k qps (spaced 5m apart)
- embedding mix: batch size 16, gen mix: dynamic batching with max_tokens=512
I'll run the harness and share results.
kim (Product): Add routing policy: prefer cheaper model (13B) if p95 > 300ms, otherwise route to 70B. Need to capture quality metrics too.
eli (Solutions Eng): Running a local harness now. Command I'm using: 
```
rbench run --scenario mixed --gen-model rwd-70b-q4 --embed-model rwd-embed-2k --qps 300 --burst 2000 --dur 3600 --batch-embed 16 --max-tokens 512
```
(ops-bot): Deploy started: benchmark-harness-2026-06-01 on infra-prod-small (trace: TB-8792).
jordan (SRE): Reminder: customer KMS means TLS+KMS call per model load for private keys. Expect ~8-12ms extra on cold starts. Include warmup to avoid penalty.
eli (Solutions Eng): First run (70B q4) — sustained 300 qps for 1h. Quick numbers: median latency gen=128ms, p95=342ms, p99=820ms. Embeddings median=22ms. Cost estimate (hosted): approx $2.8k for the hour at committed rates, burst surcharge +$1.1k.
marisol (AE): Those p95 numbers for 70B are above the 150ms target. Any tuning we can do?
eli (Solutions Eng): We saw p95 spikes correlated with cold KV-cache misses and batching variance. Mitigations: increase prefix caching, bump continuous batching window from 10ms to 25ms (trades a bit of median latency), and enable 4-bit quant path where quality acceptable. I'll re-run with those flags.
(ops-bot): Benchmark update: harness run completed (id: BH-442). Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/bench/BH-442 — logs + latency histograms.
eli (Solutions Eng): Re-run with caching + batching adjust + quant kink: results: median=160ms, p95=178ms, p99=360ms. Embedding unchanged. Cost down ~18% vs previous run because of better batching.
kim (Product): That's promising — within range if prospect relaxes median to 160ms. Suggest offering canary routing option to default 13B for <=150ms while using 70B for higher-quality fallbacks.
jordan (SRE): Also tested KMS path: end-to-end p95 added ~9ms. No further blockers from infra side.
marisol (AE): Pricing ask from NovusPay: can you give a rough per-month bill for 100M tokens gen + 5M embeddings with target SLOs and 3x monthly microbursts?
eli (Solutions Eng): Rough calc (hosted, incl burst buffer): 
- Gen tokens: 100M tokens => baseline compute $X (using run-rate) => estimate $22k/month
- Embeddings: 5M units => $1.2k/month
- Burst reserve (ops + capacity buffer): add $5k/mo
- KMS premium: $800/mo 
Total ~ $29k/mo (ballpark). I'll put a detailed spreadsheet in the prospect folder.
marisol (AE): Sales needs that spreadsheet and a short summary slide for the exec team tomorrow. Can you prod the docs?
eli (Solutions Eng): Will do. Uploading artifacts and a short runbook for the POC (warmup commands, config tweaks, canary routing snippet).
eli (Solutions Eng): Runbook excerpt: 
```
# Warmup
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-70b-q4","input":"warmup"}'; sleep 1; done

# Canary routing example
{
  "policy": "latency_threshold",
  "threshold_ms": 150,
  "primary": "rwd-13b-q4",
  "fallback": "rwd-70b-q4"
}
```
marisol (AE): Perfect. Jordan — any enterprise blockers left (compliance, network) before we hand off to NovusPay security?
jordan (SRE): Need completed security questionnaire (they requested ISO controls section) and a short diagram showing VPC peering and key flow. I'll draft both. No infra blockers otherwise.
kim (Product): We'll include a note about A/B quality checks — we ran a few prompts and QA showed negligible quality delta for their use-case. Attach in the deck.
marisol (AE): Great — next steps: eli to upload sheet + runbook, jordan to draft sec artifacts, kim to attach QA notes, I’ll prep exec slide and schedule demo for Thursday 10am PST.
eli (Solutions Eng): Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/assets/novuspay/pocevidence.zip (benchmarks + spreadsheets + configs).
marisol (AE): Thanks — marking as in-flight. :rocket:
jordan (SRE): I'll start the security doc now and ping when done.
kim (Product): I'll add the quality notes later today.
marisol (AE): Nice work team.
